# SingLinkVPN Free VPN and Open-Source Project

> SingLinkVPN is a free VPN for Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and Linux with open-source tools, the open-source first-generation SingLink protocol and SingLinkVPN client, security-audit evidence, no-logs verification and Sola protocol research.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/SingLinkVPN
Official website: https://singlinkvpn.com/
News and technical center: https://singlinknews.com/
Machine-readable project record: https://singlinklabs.github.io/SingLinkVPN/metadata/project.json

## Evidence

- Desktop 2.5 security audit: https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlinkvpn-security-audit
- 2026 no-logs verification: https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlinkvpn-no-logs-report
- Evidence index: https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlinkvpn-security-reports

## Open-source project

- Phase 2 (released 2026-11-12): after an internal security audit, the first-generation SingLink protocol and the first-generation SingLinkVPN client are open source under Apache-2.0
- SingLink Protocol, first generation (SingLink/1; Go; signed device-bound access passes, inner end-to-end encryption, hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 key exchange; internal security audit with 31 findings, all High and Medium fixed; third-party audit planned): https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-protocol
- SingLinkVPN first-generation client (Windows, macOS, Android, iOS; Flutter + Go): https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-vpn-app
- Open-source hub: https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-vpn-open-source
- Lineage: the SingLink protocol evolved from SingLinkVPN's early versions and SingLink Beta to today's SingLink 2.0; the first-generation protocol and client carry forward its design principles (account-based permissions, device binding, security by design)
- Not yet fully public, for security reasons: the latest versions (SingLink 2.0 core and current official apps), servers, payment and nodes; the open-source plan continues with further phases after security review
- Announcements: https://singlinkvpn.com/en/blog/singlink-protocol-open-source/ and https://singlinkvpn.com/en/blog/singlinkvpn-app-open-source/
- Official open-source page: https://singlinkvpn.com/en/tech/open-source/
- Repository: https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/SingLinkVPN
- Open-source plan: https://singlinknews.com/singlink-vpn-open-source-plan
